opportunities.title: Small Grants

amount.raw: Awards generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000 and will only exceptionally exceed £6,000. Travel and subsistence in Japan up to £2,000 per person for trips up to 13 days, up to £2,500 per person for 14 days or more; PhD fieldwork visits of six months or more up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider individuals with proof of organisational support. Not for undergraduate or master's students.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that deepen mutual understanding, encourage exchange of ideas or expertise, or develop lasting collaboration between the two nations. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits/exchange.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record; consideration also given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration; early-career applications particularly welcomed. Projects must involve partners in both the UK and Japan.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
